connector.name: Chain.Love MCP
connector.registryDescription: Hosted MCP gateway for Web3 infra discovery across 20+ networks via one endpoint.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.chain.love over streamable HTTP. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace love.chain.app. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

headers.name: x-chainlove-cred-github
headers.description: Optional session-scoped credential example for downstream MCP access. This example uses GitHub: send your raw GitHub token in x-chainlove-cred-github. Other downstream MCP credentials can be passed similarly using x-chainlove-cred-<credential_key>.
